title: I made a minimalist, ad-free Match 3 clone to scratch that puzzle itch
author: dogoidoso
selftext:
Hi everyone! I'm new here and wanted to share a proof of concept I built for a Match 3 game (like Candy Crush) using Lovable, which I made to start learning how to use the tool.   
  
The game is live at:

[https://minimalistmatch3.lovable.app/](https://minimalistmatch3.lovable.app/)

I really love Match 3 games for the matching mechanic itself (it makes my autistic brain happy), but I was always miserable dealing with artificially difficult levels designed to drain your lives, irrelevant backstories, and constant pop-ups for microtransactions I had zero interest in. To fix this (and learn Lovable), I quickly put together a Match 3 clone with a few key features:

* **Endless mode:** The game has no levels. It just keeps going indefinitely. If you reach a point where no moves are possible, it automatically reshuffles the board.
* **Zero distractions:** No animations, music, or sound effects. I usually mute games anyway to listen to my own music in the background. The goal here is just making matches—nothing more, nothing less.
* **Time tracking:** It features a score counter and an active timer showing how long your current session has been running. This is meant to provide a clear visual indicator to help track your screen time.
* **Instant restart:** You can start a new game whenever you want.
* **Pure gameplay:** No ads, no pop-ups, no microtransactions, and no waiting for lives to refill. Just the puzzle.

I don't have an Apple or Google App Store developer account, but if anyone here does and wants to clone the project, improve it, and upload it, please feel free! It's not like I'm reinventing the wheel or creating a radically innovative game here. I just built it to have something to play on my phone while waiting in line or commuting on public transit.

Suggestions for improvements are more than welcome!
